# Set up
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")

# Define pathogen
pat_l <- c("rota", "vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav", "men", "strep", "polio", "hib",
              "ipv", "opv", "dipht", "dtpa", "dtpw", "tetan", "pertu", "hbv",
              "multi_ipv", "multi_pertu", "multi_men", "multi_polio", "multi_opv",
              "multi_dtp", "multi_dtpa", "multi_dtpw", "multi_hib-men", "multi_mmr", "multi_mmr-vzv")

pat_l <- c("rota")
```

# Loop it s08 sub kgc 
```{r}
mcom_l <- sapply(str_subset(list.files("../outputs/modres_mcom", full.names = TRUE), ".rds"), readRDS, simplify = FALSE)
names(mcom_l) <- str_remove_all(names(mcom_l), "../outputs/modres_mcom/mcom_|.rds")

test <- sapply(str_subset(names(mcom_l), "csi_base"), function(x) {
  lapply(mcom_l[[x]], function(x) {
    unlist(lapply(x, function(x) {x$bf
      no = x$bf
      if(is.null(no)) no = NA
      return(no)
      }))
      }) %>%
    bind_cols()
}, simplify = FALSE) 


bind_cols(test) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  mutate(name = str_replace(name, "multi_", "multi")) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("bm","s0", "dat","pathogen", "mod", "r", "reg")) %>%
  select(pathogen, reg, value) %>%
  # filter(!(pathogen %in% c("hav", "multihibmen", "ipv","opv","polio", "pertu", "dipht", "tetan",
  #                          "multipertu", "multimmrv"))) %>%
  mutate(reg = as.character(glue("reg_{reg}"))) %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  mutate(mean_value = mean(value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(updown = value >= 10^0.5) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  #filter(value > 10^-20) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = reorder(pathogen, mean_value), color = updown)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous("Bayes factor (photoperiod model over base model)", trans = "log10") + 
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  scale_color_viridis_d(begin = 0.25, end = 0.75) + 
  facet_grid(reg~.) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")

```

#mcom_l <- sapply(str_subset(list.files("outputs/_mcom/photoclim", full.names = TRUE), ".rds"), readRDS, simplify = FALSE)

test_csi <- sapply(str_subset(names(mcom_l), "csi_base"), function(x) {
  lapply(mcom_l[[x]], function(x) {
    unlist(lapply(x, function(x) {x$bf
      no = x$bf
      if(is.null(no)) no = NA
      return(no)
      }))
      }) %>%
    bind_cols()
}, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_cols() %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  mutate(name = str_replace(name, "multi_", "multi"),
         name = str_replace(name, "kgc_", "kgc"),
         name = str_replace(name, "reg_", "reg")) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("bm","s0", "pathogen", "mod", "reg", "df"), sep = "_") %>%
  select(mod, pathogen, reg, df, value) %>%
  mutate(kgc = "csi")


test_cs2i <- sapply(str_subset(names(mcom_l), "cs2i_csi"), function(x) {
  lapply(mcom_l[[x]], function(x) {
    unlist(lapply(x, function(x) {x$bf
      no = x$bf
      if(is.null(no)) no = NA
      return(no)
      }))
      }) %>%
    bind_cols()
}, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_cols() %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  mutate(name = str_replace(name, "multi_", "multi"),
         name = str_replace(name, "kgc_", "kgc"),
         name = str_replace(name, "reg_", "reg")) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("bm","s0", "pathogen", "mod", "kgc", "reg", "df"), sep = "_") %>%
  select(mod, pathogen, kgc, reg, df, value) 

bind_rows(test_cs2i, test_csi) %>%
  mutate(updown = value >= 10^0.5) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = mod, color = updown, shape = kgc)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous("Bayes factor (photoperiod model over base model)", trans = "log10") + 
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  scale_color_viridis_d(begin = 0.25, end = 0.75) + 
  facet_grid(pathogen~reg, scales = "free") + 
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())

mcom_l$hbv_cs2i_csi_dfkgc1$bmvl_s08_hbv_cs2i_kgc_1_reg_2b_dfkgc1.rds
